game.name: IL-2 Sturmovik : Birds of Prey (Poland)
game.desc: IL-2 Sturmovik: Birds of Prey is the Xbox 360 adaptation of the popular PC aircraft simulation series. The player visualises the damage his plane takes (holes in the wings, smoke trails) during frenzied battles, in a World War II atmosphere. The arcade and simulation modes allow you to adjust the degree of realism.
